crossRefs.note: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.
I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my…

translations.web: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
translations.bsb: When I remember, terror takes hold, and my body trembles in horror.
translations.kjv: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
translations.asv: Even when I remember I am troubled, And horror taketh hold on my flesh.
